finding.title: Protect the production forward-end conversion call
finding.fact: New save_k tests invoke convert_pending_k_blocks directly. Layout tests invoke page conversion directly. The existing heterogeneous forward test uses four tokens and checks forward stats, so it does not complete a 16-token block or assert conversion.
finding.consequence: Deleting the production call, or moving it ahead of the staging barrier, is not distinguished by the new conversion assertions. No observed production failure is claimed.
finding.remedy: Extend a production-forward test to complete a previously partial block and assert converted state and retained K values on return. If testing ordering, hold a staging reader until the barrier and check its rows before release.
finding.validation: Discriminating mutation: remove line 1847; the production-forward test must fail. Mutation not run during this review.

tron.ownership: Page pointers survive the forward under scheduler-owned books. EAGLE view resets after state.forward. Staging copies K rows synchronously into owned GOF buffers before DMA submission. Pending conversions execute after all staging population/submission calls return. DMA continues reading GOF buffers, not source pages.
